question: What further domains of experience are always included in Śiva-nature?
premises: What is to be reached, grasped, and spoken is included.
Pleasure and other states are included.
This inclusion holds at all times.
inference: All domains of action and feeling are always pervaded by Śiva.
plain_english: In what is to be reached, grasped, and spoken, and likewise in pleasure and so on, always—
